companyDescription: AAV gene therapy developer · NAVSUNLI (RGX-121) for Hunter syndrome — FDA Type A meeting held Jul 2026, confirmed no additional studies needed; Q2 2026 turned profitable on a $100M AbbVie milestone · RGX-202 Duchenne BLA pathway also advancing
priceNote: Pulled back from $11.28 to $10.72, still well up from the pre-Jun-22 base despite today's dip. Q2 2026 results (Aug 6, 2026) beat on EPS and delivered a rare profitable quarter ($108M revenue, $22.7M net income) on a $100M AbbVie milestone recognition — cash runway now extends into Q4 2027.
summary: Two real updates since the last report. First, the FDA Type A meeting happened in July 2026 as planned and went well: the FDA reaffirmed that no additional patients or studies are required for the NAVSUNLI BLA resubmission, which stays on track for Q3 2026 with longer-term efficacy/safety data plus a post-approval confirmatory study to be discussed at review. Second, Q2 2026 earnings (Aug 6) showed a genuine financial inflection — $108M revenue (vs $21.4M a year ago) and $22.7M net income, driven by a $100M AbbVie milestone payment, extending cash runway into Q4 2027 and reducing near-term dilution risk. The core binary — will the Q3 BLA resubmission be accepted cleanly — is still ahead, with a $23.10 consensus target implying over 100% upside.

catalysts.name: NAVSUNLI BLA Resubmission
catalysts.description: Following the positive Jul 2026 FDA Type A meeting (no additional studies required), REGENXBIO still targets Q3 2026 for the formal BLA resubmission, which will include longer-term efficacy/safety data and participant imaging already submitted to FDA. A post-approval confirmatory study will be discussed as part of the review.

catalysts.name: FDA Type A Meeting (completed, positive)
catalysts.description: Held Jul 2026: the FDA reaffirmed the existing NAVSUNLI clinical data is sufficient for the accelerated-approval pathway, with no new patients or studies required — the key uncertainty from the last report is now resolved in the company's favor.

catalysts.name: RGX-202 (Duchenne) BLA Pathway
catalysts.description: Separate program: AFFINITY DUCHENNE Phase III met its primary endpoint (93% of patients above 10% microdystrophin expression), supporting an accelerated-approval BLA strategy and a potential 2027 commercial launch — independent optionality alongside the NAVSUNLI catalyst, nearing its own BLA per Q2 commentary.

risks: The Type A meeting outcome is positive but not a guarantee — the FDA's own gene-therapy track record has been inconsistent this cycle (uniQure's AMT-130 saw a similar 2024 alignment reversed by the FDA in 2026); a Q3 resubmission still needs to clear formal review, not just the pre-meeting alignment
The Q2 profit was driven by a one-time $100M AbbVie milestone recognition, not recurring operating profitability — don't extrapolate the net-income swing as a new steady-state
Analyst target range remains unusually wide ($10-50) — genuine disagreement on approval probability and timeline, not just normal estimate noise
The 'Q3 2026' BLA resubmission target is still the company's own timeline, not an FDA-mandated deadline — it could slip without new bad news

Small-cap biotech volatility cuts both ways: the same mechanics that drove a +37% pop on the Jun 22 FDA reversal drove a -21% drop on the original Feb 2026 CRL — size accordingly even with the improved cash position

estimateDates.note: Targeted following the positive Jul 2026 Type A meeting; FDA has committed to an expedited review
Nearing submission per Q2 2026 commentary — independent optionality

analystTargets.note: Updated consensus post-Type-A-meeting and Q2 results
Carried from prior coverage — highest named target
Most conservative among named targets — still a Buy but flags timeline/probability caution

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Fed held at 3.50-3.75% on Jul 29, 2026, with 3 of 12 officials dissenting toward a hike — the most hawkish split since 2016. RGNX's improved cash position (runway into Q4 2027) reduces near-term financing dependence on favorable rate conditions versus the last report.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Core PCE still 3.3% YoY, above target. CPI (Aug 12) could still move small-cap biotech risk appetite broadly, though RGNX is now less exposed given the extended cash runway.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Biotech regulatory catalysts are largely macro-independent — an FDA decision doesn't care about interest rates — and RGNX's post-AbbVie-milestone balance sheet reduces the financing-cost exposure flagged in the prior report.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — the FDA pathway itself remains idiosyncratic and macro-independent, and the extended cash runway (into Q4 2027) meaningfully reduces the financing-driven macro exposure from the last report, though a broad risk-off could still pressure the stock independent of the regulatory news flow.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Small-cap gene-therapy names in this cohort react same-day to FDA correspondence rather than grinding up beforehand — REGENXBIO's own Jun 22, 2026 pop happened immediately on the reversal news, and the Jul Type A meeting outcome was similarly absorbed quickly rather than pre-run.

postWin.note: REGENXBIO's own Jun 22, 2026 FDA alignment/reversal news drove a premarket pop of up to 37%. General biotech sector pattern for small-cap approval news runs 30-100%+ depending on how much was already priced in.

postLose.note: REGENXBIO's own Feb 2026 Complete Response Letter for the same NAVSUNLI program sent shares down 21% in a single session — the exact same-company, same-program precedent for what a Q3 resubmission setback would look like.
